entities.name: Digital Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The shift from analog to digital technology beginning in the 1970s, accelerating with personal computers (1980s), the World Wide Web (1990s), and smartphones (2000s). It transformed communication, commerce, media, and virtually every aspect of modern life.
